avis.titre: Not worth the price! You only get one use out of this!
avis.texte: Ok, while I'm pleased with how much gunk and stray peach fuzz this removed, I was incredibly disappointed when I realized this only came with one set of face patches (5 patches does not mean 5 uses for the full face, it literally meant 5 pieces in 1 single set for 1 use, I misunderstood) that meant the price was absolutely not worth it for me, even at 30% off for the black friday deal. I think you'd be better off buying each specific patch you need in their respective individual packs, you'll end up getting more for your money!

ive tried these larger patches multiple times now. they hurt like crazy to peel off no matter which direction I pull. my skin is bright red and painful afterwards. their pimple patches are great, these are a miss for me.

avis.titre: Unexpected Skin Reaction After Using This Product
avis.texte: I wanted to share my experience in case it helps others. After using this product my skin became extremely red, irritated, and painful immediately after removing the patches. I experienced noticeable burning and tightness, especially on my cheeks and around my eyes (see attached photos). I followed the directions exactly and have not had this type of reaction to other skincare products before. I had to stop using it immediately and apply a soothing product to calm my skin. If you have sensitive skin or allergies, I recommend doing a patch test first or consulting a dermatologist before use. I really wish this product had worked for me, but unfortunately, it caused a severe reaction. I hope the company takes feedback like this seriously and reviews the formulation.
Had a bad reaction to this on my forehead. Dealt with red acne like bumps for a week afterwards!

I love these, they help keep my skin so clear. I found these a little difficult to remove for application initially but now have the hang of it. If you have clogged pores or even cystic break out they really help eliminate or greatly reduce breakouts.
